Regarding the potential insider threats described in the text, the primary suspect is the former research and development team lead. Several risk factors point to this individual: the disappearance of several prototypes coincided with his resignation, he was observed working late hours which was unusual behavior for him, and there were no signs of forced entry, suggesting he had legitimate access to the items. The fact that the prototypes were last accounted for in his possession further strengthens the indication of an insider threat involving theft or unauthorized removal of intellectual property.
